prompt:
Research the officially documented limits of a free Gmail / Google account: total storage, attachment size for sending and receiving, recipients per day. Cite Google's own help pages and quote the limits.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Here are the officially documented limits for a free Gmail / Google account, based on Google's help pages.

SOURCE: https://support.google.com/mail/answer/9312312 | QUOTE: "Each Google Account includes up to 15 GB of storage, which is shared across Gmail, Google Drive, and Google Photos." | CLAIM: The total storage limit for a free Gmail / Google account is 15 GB, shared across Gmail, Google Drive, and Google Photos.
SOURCE: https://support.google.com/mail/answer/6584 | QUOTE: "For personal Gmail accounts, the limit is 25 MB." | CLAIM: For a free personal Gmail account, the attachment size limit is 25 MB; the same page presents this as the relevant attachment limit for personal accounts and says files over the limit are added as a Google Drive link.
SOURCE: https://support.google.com/mail/answer/22839 | QUOTE: "You may see this message if you send an email to a total of more than 500 recipients in a single email and or more than 500 emails sent in a day." | CLAIM: For a free Gmail account, Google documents a limit of 500 recipients in a single email and/or 500 emails sent per day.
SOURCE: https://support.google.com/a/answer/166852 | QUOTE: "If your users exceed an email sending limit, they'll get an error message" | CLAIM: This confirms Google Workspace accounts have documented sending limits, but it does not provide the free Gmail limit.

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: a separate officially documented incoming attachment-size limit for free personal Gmail accounts, distinct from the 25 MB sending attachment limit.
